task_definition.task_name: Estimate Magnitude of Completeness using Maximum Curvature

task_description.overview: Estimate the magnitude of completeness (Mc) by finding the magnitude bin with maximum frequency in the non-cumulative frequency-magnitude distribution and applying a correction factor.
steps: Load the earthquake catalog containing event magnitudes.
Define the magnitude bin width (Δm) for the frequency-magnitude distribution (FMD).
Compute the number of events in each magnitude bin.
Identify the bin with the maximum count (maximum curvature).
Add the correction factor (δ) to the bin magnitude to avoid underestimation.
Return the estimated Mc and the correction factor used.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Estimate the magnitude of completeness (Mc) by the Maximum Curvature method. Loading the earthquake catalog at {catalog_path}, bin the magnitudes with bin width {fmd_bin}, and apply the Maximum Curvature method to estimate the magnitude of completeness Mc (`cat.estimate_mc_maxc()`). Report the estimated Mc and the correction factor used, plot a figure to show the magnitude of completeness. 
 Note: 1) The `seismostats` libarary is usefule for catalog statistic analysis and ploting. Please using or refer to the provided functions in `seismostats` 
 2) Save the mc data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content} and the mc plot to {result_plot}.
